items.snippet: Rail Vikas Nigam reported Q2 FY27 net profit growth of 10% to ₹253.71 crore, despite an 8.24% revenue decline. Operating profit rose 19.51%. For H1, net profit increased 13.25% and operating profit surged 62.29%, while revenue was nearly flat.
